title: AnimObject
content:
Type: ANIO
Papyrus: None AnimObjects represent props that will be created and used as part of an animation, typically an idle animation. For example, the hoe used in the raking idle animation is an AnimObject. The AnimObject object is found within the Object Window under the Miscellaneous Category. Editor Dialog: File:AnimObject Editor.png - - - Unload Event The event that will be sent by the animation when the object needs to be removed. Behavior graph filter: See Also: - Miscellaneous Category
